## Checklist

- [ ] Title uses a `feat:` / `fix:` / `chore:` / `docs:` prefix (drives release notes)
- [ ] `cd backend && python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run lint` passes (if frontend changed)
- [ ] New env vars documented in `.env.example` and the README table (if any)
